title: The Thorn of Highmoor
author: Zephyrine Nakamura
blurb: Cyrus Nystrom, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
